regime: Long-end yield stress + refined-product inflation + selective scarcity/hedge rotation
summary: The immediate market gate remains high nominal/real yields plus Iran/Hormuz refined-product inflation. Gold/monetary hedges are structurally strengthening but tactically fragile into the September Fed decision; crypto remains constructive medium term but more liquidity-sensitive. Corporate breakups are creating selective pure-play opportunities, especially FLEX/SOLS/LHX, while critical-mineral sovereignty is phasing in through real producers such as Lynas and MP. Current-holding fundamental scores remain separate from this tactical overlay.

Broader duration stress still raises the valuation hurdle: $216–217 remains first support; sustained <~$210 triggers reassessment; $228–233 and >$235 are recovery levels.

The active oil theme helps sentiment but has still not converted into operating proof. RM1.42 remains critical support; require RM1.50–1.52 reclaim plus better utilisation/work-order conversion before fresh capital.
